corrections.compiler_and_flags: clang 7.0 64-bit on macOS (README sample results, updated 2016-9-9); premake5 gmake build (build/premake.sh) in release configuration: optimize Full, NDEBUG, -march=native (build/premake5.lua)

notes: Every figure checks out against the CSV (parse totals Jansson 112.06, JsonCpp 165.52, json-c 134.55, Nlohmann 72.48 ms; stringify Jansson 69.91, JsonCpp 94.26, Nlohmann 87.73, json-c 30.80 ms), and the schemaless-benchmarks caveat numbers and quote are also verified. tier_reason: First-party README Performance section only: author's own json_benchmark and sanSS json-bechmarks runs with no compiler, flags, hardware or library versions; the jbson adapter code is not public (repo has only doc/, include/, test/, and mloskot/json_benchmark lists neither jbson nor jsoncons).

corrections.caveats: First-party run: the README gives the author's own timings with no compiler, flags, hardware or library versions, so tier C even though mloskot/json_benchmark is public (its own README lists no jbson or jsoncons row and shows different absolute times on other hardware); the jbson benchmark adapters are not published anywhere found (no bench directory in the repo). It is slower than RapidJSON (small 0.454 to 0.486 s, large 4.857 to 4.863 s, so about 9x on large) and, on small input, slower than QJsonDocument (1.046 to 1.056 s). json_reader parses straight into a BSON byte buffer that is then read through iterators, a different data model from the DOMs it is compared with. README's large-object memory figure is garbled ('70,7748 K'). README says the library is known to work only with an up-to-date libc++. 2015 numbers, repository last changed 2015-12-20. Both benchmark repos are unmaintained or superseded by nativejson-benchmark, which has no jbson row.

notes: All README numbers and derived ratios check out (large 43.0 vs jsoncpp 62.8 s = 1.46x, QJsonDocument 1.35x, jsoncons 5.7x; small about 1.9x vs jsoncpp; sanSS medium 64,800 vs 121,035 us). Metadata verified: BSL-1.0, 38 stars, not archived, last commit 2015-12-20 (abandoned). Shortcomings: first-party, unpublished adapter, no methodology, slower than RapidJSON and (small input) QJsonDocument, different data model (BSON buffer).

tier_reason: First-party Google Benchmark code is public (benchmarks/serialization.cpp) and the chart numbers match the record, but compiler, flags and exact CPU model are missing (only 'Core i5' alt text; benchmarks/CMakeLists.txt and root CMakeLists.txt set no build type or optimisation flags), and the yaml-cpp gain is about 98x with unstated flags, so capped at C.

corrections.caveats: Numbers exist only inside chart images (read from benchmarks/performance_chart.png); the README text gives no figures. Compiler, build type, flags and CPU model are not stated, and neither benchmarks/CMakeLists.txt nor the root CMakeLists.txt sets a build type or optimisation flags. The benchmark compares different jobs: Easy Reflection builds or dumps a typed struct, while nlohmann, RapidJSON and yaml-cpp build or dump a generic DOM. The README justifies this by saying the others do not convert strings to int, float or bool until accessed, which does not hold for nlohmann::json::parse or RapidJSON Document::Parse (both convert numbers and booleans at parse time). One small 2.9 KB document only (boba_fett.json, 2933 bytes). The yaml-cpp ratios (about 98x and 15x) are implausibly large for unstated flags; the yaml-cpp serialization case streams a YAML::Node through std::ostream, and the README itself says 'if I did the benchmark right'. Outputs are not checked for equivalence. The README calls the project 'mostly a proof of concept' and tells users who want this in production to use glaze instead. Repository archived and read-only since 2026-08-20 (the last commits that day only update the README; the last code change is 2025-02-04).

notes: Chart values confirmed exactly (er JSON ser 2.8 vs nlohmann 9.3 us, deser 17.4 vs 20.8, simdjson path 5.7; YAML 3.4 vs 331.8 and 18.1 vs 274.5; RapidJSON 3.4 and 7.4) and the benchmark loop does real work for every library (no no-op found). Metadata verified: Apache-2.0, 104 stars, archived 2026-08-20, last commit 2026-08-20 (README-only). Shortcomings: unstated flags and CPU, typed struct vs generic DOM, single 2.9 KB document, implausible yaml-cpp ratios, proof-of-concept project that points to glaze, archived.
